# cubepath_object_storage_usage (Data Source)

Fetches the Object Storage usage and cost of a month.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `period` (String) Month in YYYY-MM format, at most 12 months back. Defaults to the current month.
- `project_id` (Number) Only include this project's buckets.

### Read-Only

- `buckets` (Attributes List) Usage per bucket. Quantities are null when metrics are unavailable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `metrics_available` (Boolean) False when usage metrics are temporarily unavailable (costs are still returned).
- `projected_cost` (Number) USD projected for the whole month.
- `total_cost` (Number) USD charged so far in the month.

<a id="nestedatt--buckets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `buckets`

Read-Only:

- `class_a_requests` (Number) Class A requests.
- `class_b_requests` (Number) Class B requests.
- `cost` (Number) USD charged for the bucket in the month.
- `egress_bytes` (Number) Billable egress in bytes.
- `name` (String) Bucket name.
- `storage_gib_month` (Number) GiB-month stored.
- `uuid` (String) Bucket UUID.
